'Sri Veeranjaneya Swamy' is the canonical temple name; 'Balanjaneya' appears only as the smaller idol's name in TWO_IDOLS data (data.js line 97) — exactly as required. FORMS: RSVP submitted → data-testid='rsvp-success' shown; Contact submitted → data-testid='contact-success' shown; backend received both. action_items: (Non-blocking, persists from iteration 3/4) Hydration warning on /events: build-time x-source instrumentation injects <span data-ve-dynamic='true'> inside <option> elements of the RSVP event-select. HTML disallows <span> as a child of <option> so React logs a hydration mismatch. Not user-visible — a build-tool artifact, not app code. Consider opting the <select><option> children out of x-source instrumentation, or rendering options via static string children only.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend POST endpoints (/api/events/register, /api/contact) still return 200 on creation instead of 201 — convention nit, non-blocking.
CORS_ORIGINS still defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo for cookie-bearing requests; explicit origin list recommended for production.
Home.jsx is approaching the 500-line mark; if more sections are added consider splitting Hero / Sections into separate files under /pages/home/.

Reveal IntersectionObserver wraps everything — off-screen elements start at opacity:0 with no fallback; users with JS disabled / very old browsers see nothing. Consider a <noscript> reveal-disabled CSS or an initial visibility for above-the-fold content.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 8 routes render, hero matches the poster reference, masthead+nav correct, WCAG AA passes, forbidden draft text absent, both temple names correctly applied, forms submit, gallery lightbox + mobile menu functional

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (8 tests, all green) — runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Hero is now data-testid='home-hero' with poster layout (Bevan slab serif font + terracotta #A93822). Section headings use class 'font-poster text-poster-md' and many use Tailwind 'uppercase' so when asserting via inner_text() match UPPERCASE strings, not title-case. Notice/blessing numbering is rendered as 'N°1' (Unicode degree symbol, not 'No.' or '#'). Forms still use *-input / *-submit-btn / *-success testid pattern. Hayagreeva, Mantra, Rampura, Visit pages pick up new palette via CSS variables — .text-crimson aliases .text-terracotta so legacy class refs still resolve. Mobile nav testid slug rule: lowercase, spaces→dash (e.g. 'The Temple' → 'mobile-nav-the-temple').
rca of the issue: No bugs found this iteration. The vintage travel-poster redesign meets every checklist item: poster-style hero with massive Bevan terracotta wordmark, side-stack labels, sun-circle, brushstroke accents, coordinate strip, NEXT CEREMONY callout, 'THE RAMPURA GAZETTE' masthead in terracotta, all 8 routes rendering, no forbidden draft text, both temple names correctly applied, all forms + gallery + mobile menu functional, and all sampled text/background pairs pass WCAG AA (≥4.5:1). The only outstanding nit is the pre-existing build-tool hydration warning on the RSVP <select><option> chain, which is non-user-visible.
